name: Project Week (TUM Bio Entrepreneurship): Venture Building with TUM Venture Labs
description:
Central challenges in healthcare can only be solved when different disciplines come together. In this project week, students from medicine, computer science, and management jointly develop biomedical innovations, from the initial idea to the pitch. The following content is covered:

- Fundamentals of entrepreneurial thinking in the biomedical environment: What makes innovation special in highly regulated and clinically shaped markets?
- Structured innovation: from open problem exploration to a focused solution
- Interdisciplinary teamwork: how scientific, clinical, and entrepreneurial perspectives come together to form viable ideas
- Understanding and validating needs: identifying unmet clinical needs and translating them into a compelling value proposition
- From idea to implementation: designing business models, building initial prototypes, and presenting results
